# tfctl CLI overview

The tfctl CLI is a command-line interface that allows you to manage HCP Terraform runs, variables, and workspaces, and provides direct API access for advanced automation. You can integrate tfctl with your LLM agents to support AI-assisted workflows.

## Introduction

The tfctl CLI supports several common HCP Terraform operations with named subcommands, and provides full access to the HCP Terraform API for agentic workflows. It simplifies authentication, workspace management, and API interactions, allowing you to integrate HCP Terraform into your automation pipelines and development workflows.

## Workflows

The following sections describe the primary workflows for using tfctl.

### Install tfctl

To begin using tfctl, install it on your local machine. Refer to [Install tfctl](/terraform/tfctl-cli/install) for instructions

1. Authenticate with HCP Terraform using your credentials.
1. Configure your profile settings to specify default organizations and workspaces.

### Authenticate with HCP Terraform

Next, authenticate tfctl with HCP Terraform. Refer to [Authenticate with HCP Terraform](/terraform/tfctl-cli/authenticate) for instructions.

### Configure tfctl

The tfctl CLI uses a layered configuration system. You can configure settings in profiles, environment variables, or local Terraform configuration, in order of precedence.

#### Set default organization

Run the [`tfctl profile set`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile/set) command to set the default organization. Replace `<ORGANIZATION>` with your HCP Terraform or Terraform Enterprise organization name:

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile set default_organization <ORGANIZATION>
```

#### Manage profiles

Use the `tfctl profile profiles` command group to create and manage profiles. You can use seperate profiles to manage HCP Terraform organizations and instances of HCP Terraform and Terraform Enterprise.

To create a profile, run the `tfctl profile profiles create` command and specify a name. Replace `<PROFILE>` with a name for your new profile:

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles create <PROFILE>
```

The CLI activates the new profile automatically. Use [`tfctl profile set`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/profile/set) to set configuration options for the currently active profile.

#### Integrate with agents

To integrate tfctl with your AI agent, install agent skills with tfctl or NPM. Refer to [Install AI agent skill](/terraform/tfctl-cli/authentication#install-ai-agent-skill) for detailed instructions.

The tfctl CLI is open source. To contribute to the project or build from source, visit the [tfctl-cli repository on GitHub](https://github.com/hashicorp/tfctl-cli). The repository includes detailed developer documentation, contribution guidelines, and instructions for building from source.
